metadata.question: Were there more than 8 active fires in the Sakha Republic on August 6, 2020?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use MODIS MCD14DL (Collection 061) active fire detections (FeatureCollection) for August 6, 2020, filtered to the Sakha Republic boundary from FAO GAUL 2015 Level 1 (filter ADM0_NAME='Russian Federation' and ADM1_NAME contains 'Sakha' or 'Yakut'). If empty, fallback to MODIS/006/MCD14DL, then widen date ±1 day. 
2. Masking strategy: Not applicable (point detections). No cloud masking required.
3. Logic for validity: If collections are empty after fallback, output C1. If count is null/invalid, output C3. Otherwise compare count > 8 for A/B.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

function getInfoAsync(obj) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    obj.getInfo((res, err) => {
      if (err) reject(err);
      else resolve(res);
    });
  });
}

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const start = '2020-08-06';
    const end = '2020-08-07';
    const gaul = ee.FeatureCollection('FAO/GAUL/2015/level1');
    const russiaL1 = gaul.filter(ee.Filter.eq('ADM0_NAME', 'Russian Federation'));
    const sakhaFc = russiaL1.filter(
      ee.Filter.or(
        ee.Filter.stringContains('ADM1_NAME', 'Sakha'),
        ee.Filter.stringContains('ADM1_NAME', 'Yakut'),
        ee.Filter.stringContains('ADM1_NAME', 'Yakutiya'),
        ee.Filter.eq('ADM1_NAME', 'Sakha (Yakutiya) Republic')
      )
    );
    const sakhaCount = await getInfoAsync(sakhaFc.size());
    if (!sakhaCount || sakhaCount === 0) {
      console.log('GAUL L1 Sakha matches: 0');
      console.log('Region not found in GAUL L1.');
      console.log('C1: Empty Collection');
      return;
    }
    const sakhaGeom = sakhaFc.geometry();
    console.log('GAUL L1 Sakha matches:', sakhaCount);

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check with fallback strategy
    let datasetId = 'MODIS/061/MCD14DL';
    let fires = ee.FeatureCollection(datasetId)
      .filterBounds(sakhaGeom)
      .filterDate(start, end);
    let count = await getInfoAsync(fires.size());

    if (count === 0) {
      // Fallback 1: prior collection version
      const fallbackId = 'MODIS/006/MCD14DL';
      let fires006 = ee.FeatureCollection(fallbackId)
        .filterBounds(sakhaGeom)
        .filterDate(start, end);
      let count006 = await getInfoAsync(fires006.size());
      if (count006 > 0) {
        datasetId = fallbackId;
        fires = fires006;
        count = count006;
      } else {
        // Fallback 2: widen date by ±1 day
        const widenStart = '2020-08-05';
        const widenEnd = '2020-08-07';
        const firesWide = ee.FeatureCollection(fallbackId)
          .filterBounds(sakhaGeom)
          .filterDate(widenStart, widenEnd);
        const countWide = await getInfoAsync(firesWide.size());
        console.log('Date window:', start, 'to', end);
        console.log('Dataset tried:', datasetId, 'and', fallbackId);
        console.log('Counts on exact date:', count, '(061),', count006, '(006)');
        console.log('Widened (±1 day) count (006):', countWide);
        console.log('C1: Empty Collection');
        return;
      }
    }

    // 3. Processing/Validation
    if (count === null || count === undefined || isNaN(count)) {
      console.log('Date window:', start, 'to', end);
      console.log('Dataset used:', datasetId);
      console.log('Count invalid:', count);
      console.log('C3: Calculation Failure');
      return;
    }

    // 4. Evidence prints (concise)
    console.log('Date window:', start, 'to', end);
    console.log('Dataset used:', datasetId);
    console.log('Active fire detections:', count);

    // 5. Final Answer
    if (count > 8) {
      console.log('A: Yes');
    } else {
      console.log('B: No');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    // Syntax/dataset/memory or other runtime issues
    console.log('Error:', (err && err.message) ? err.message : String(err));
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
